agent_discovery.description: Rigidly transform one metric position plus XYZW orientation from active-world, configured arm-base, or current controlled-effector coordinates into the active Fabric world frame. The read-only result exposes target_position_world_m and target_orientation_world_xyzw with frame, epoch, calibration, timestamp, and transform-path provenance. It performs no movement and does not create a world-pose motion authority.
when_to_use: A downstream operation requires a complete world pose derived from arm-base or controlled-effector coordinates.
Position and orientation must be transformed together without language-model matrix or quaternion math.
A typed, timestamped world-pose result is needed for a later independently authorized operation.
when_not_to_use: Only a direction or semantic work-object AABB point is required.
The source position, quaternion convention, or source axes are ambiguous.
No active motion-usable world-frame authority is available.

position_m.description: Source-frame [x, y, z] position in metres.

orientation_xyzw.description: Source-frame quaternion [x, y, z, w] describing the posed frame orientation. The Skill validates and normalizes it.

source_reference.description: Frame in which both position_m and orientation_xyzw are expressed.

source_frame_id.description: Optional exact upstream frame ID. Supply it unchanged when available; otherwise use null and the Skill binds the configured frame selected by source_reference.

source_observed_at_us.description: Optional upstream observation timestamp in Unix microseconds. Supply it unchanged when available; use null to request the current transform.

source_session_epoch.description: Optional upstream resettable-frame epoch. Supply it unchanged when available; otherwise use null.
